schema.units: Mpc_units (Mpc = 1.0): tau, cs_tau in Mpc; friction_F, rho_G, rho_T dimensionless (radians for the residuals).
schema.grid: The production source grid: wavenumber_exit_time.populate_z_sample reproduced by ComputeTargets.tests.wkb_reference.production_source_z_values -- descending, log-spaced in z (NOT in 1+z), 100 points per decade of z, from the 5-e-fold super-horizon point of k = 3e8/Mpc down to z = 0.1.
schema.checkpoints: A list of {index, z}: index is into the descending node array, z is the exact double of that node. tau_minus_top / cs_tau_minus_top / friction_F_minus_top are parallel lists in the same order.
schema.tau_minus_top: tau(z_j) - tau(z_top) = int_{z_j}^{z_top} dz/H > 0. This is tau.delta(z_top, z_j) in the README §2 (c) convention.
schema.cs_tau_minus_top: cs_tau(z_j) - cs_tau(z_top) = int_{z_j}^{z_top} c_s dz/H > 0, with c_s^2 = wPerturbations.
schema.friction_F_minus_top: F(z_j) - F(z_top) = -int_{z_j}^{z_top} (3/2)(1+c_s^2) dz/(1+z) < 0, where F is the primitive of TkWKBIntegration.friction_RHS (dF/dz = +(3/2)(1+c_s^2)/(1+z)). Note the sign is opposite to tau and cs_tau, which increase towards lower z.
schema.primitives_at_rho_anchor: Per k: tau_minus_top, cs_tau_minus_top and friction_F_minus_top evaluated at that k's rho anchor, which is off the node grid. Subtract these from a checkpoint's entry to obtain the primitive increment from the anchor, which is what the WKB phase from the production start point needs.
schema.rho_anchor_z: Per k: the 3-e-folds-sub-horizon redshift for that k, where the production WKB region begins. It is a root of k(1+z)/H(z) = e^3 and is deliberately OFF the node grid (RECONCILIATION.md §2 item 5).
schema.rho_G: Per k, a list of {index, z, value} for the checkpoints strictly below the anchor. value = int_z^{z_anchor} C/(omega + k/H) dz with omega^2 = (k/H)^2 + C and C the non-leading (B + C) terms of Gk_omegaEff_sq. The Green's-function phase is then theta_G(z; z_anchor) = -k*tau.delta(z_anchor, z) - value.
schema.rho_T: As rho_G, with C_T the non-leading terms of Tk_omegaEff_sq, omega_T^2 = c_s^2 (k/H)^2 + C_T and the leading primitive cs_tau. NOTE the sign convention: this is the rho of README §2 (a)/(c), theta_T = -(x - x_i) - rho_T; review §12.4's quoted 'rho_T = 1/x_i - 1/x' is its negative.
schema.short_baseline: Three one-grid-interval Delta-tau references per model, near z = 1e6, 1e2 and 1, plus the same interval truncated at an off-grid endpoint 37% of the way through it in u = log(1+z). delta_tau_full = int_{z_node_lo}^{z_node_hi} dz/H, delta_tau_fraction = int_{z_fraction}^{z_node_hi} dz/H. Both positive.
schema.method: Per model: the reference method and its own floor.

RadiationModel.method: mpmath at mp.dps = 40: mp.quad in u = log(1+z) with breakpoints at every integer power of ten of 1+z; H, epsilon, epsilon', w and w' re-derived at 40 digits from the closed forms of the cosmology model, so the reference never passes through the double-precision ModelFunctions.

reference_floor.note: mp.dps = 40 against a closed-form background; the reference's own floor is ~1e-38 relative, far below every acceptance threshold in README §6. Values are stored as doubles, so the JSON itself is the 1-ulp limit.

LambdaCDMModel.method: mpmath at mp.dps = 40: mp.quad in u = log(1+z) with breakpoints at every integer power of ten of 1+z; H, epsilon, epsilon', w and w' re-derived at 40 digits from the closed forms of the cosmology model, so the reference never passes through the double-precision ModelFunctions.

reference_floor.note: mp.dps = 40 against a closed-form background; the reference's own floor is ~1e-38 relative, far below every acceptance threshold in README §6. Values are stored as doubles, so the JSON itself is the 1-ulp limit.

QCDModel.method: converged adaptive quadrature of the double-precision integrand: SciPy quad in u = log(1+z) per production interval at epsabs=0, epsrel=1.5e-14, summed with math.fsum; cross-checked against the same at epsrel=1e-12 and against composite Gauss-Legendre order 40 with uniform bisection to rtol=1e-14 (max 8 levels). H(z) here is a spline evaluation of T(z), but since prompts/qcd-background-audit/ prompt 06 that representation is segmented at the redshifts where T(z) jumps and reproduces the defining equation T gs(T)^(1/3) = T_CMB gs(T_CMB)^(1/3) (1+z), root-solved to rtol=1e-14, to 6.807e-11 max / 3.237e-15 p90 / 1.765e-16 median on the audit's 640-point probe set (H(z) itself to 1.690e-10 / 6.276e-15 / 2.804e-16 on the production grid): this reference is therefore no longer circular, and the accurate root solve is a genuine higher-precision oracle for the background it is built on. | regenerated by docs/qcd-background-audit/generate_qcd_references.py on 2026-09-14, T_Z_REPRESENTATION_VERSION=2 | regenerated by docs/qcd-background-audit/generate_qcd_references.py on 2026-09-14, T_Z_REPRESENTATION_VERSION=3 | regenerated by docs/qcd-background-audit/generate_qcd_references.py on 2026-09-14, T_Z_REPRESENTATION_VERSION=4 | regenerated by docs/qcd-background-audit/generate_qcd_references.py on 2026-09-15, T_Z_REPRESENTATION_VERSION=6

baselines.note: phase error in radians against the JSON references at the JSON checkpoints; the sample grid is the production source grid truncated to z <= the 3-e-fold sub-horizon start point

schema.models: model -> scheme -> integrand key -> block. Scheme is 'plain' (one Gauss panel per production interval), 'branch' (panels split at the QCD_EOS temperature break points) or 'branch+knots' (also split at the T(z) spline's knots). LambdaCDMModel has only 'plain'. Within a model, every scheme is scored against the SAME break-aware converged reference.
schema.integrand keys: 'tau' = 1/H, 'cs_tau' = c_s/H, 'friction' = (3/2)(1+c_s^2)/(1+z); 'rho_G@<k>' and 'rho_T@<k>' with <k> the JSON's f'{k:.6e}' key. All are integrands in u = log(1+z).
schema.orders: Per order N: max_increment_rel_error is the largest relative error of a single production interval's Gauss increment against the converged reference; max_cumulative_abs_error and max_cumulative_rel_error are the largest absolute and relative errors of the cumulative value at a wkb_reference_data.json checkpoint (Mpc for tau/cs_tau, radians for friction and the residuals), the top checkpoint -- where the cumulative is identically zero -- being excluded from the relative measure; intervals_above_1e-12 counts intervals whose increment is worse than 1e-12 relative.
schema.decision: N_tau, N_cs_tau, N_F, N_rho are the Gauss orders prompts 03-07 must use; recommended_scheme is the QCD break-point scheme they must build the tables under; rho_adaptive_fallback_required says whether NO fixed order <= 16 met the 1e-7 rad target for rho on QCD_Cosmology under that scheme.
schema.smoothness: Finite-difference bounds on rho as a function of u = log(1+z), and the cubic spline interpolation error h^4 max|rho''''|/384 they imply -- the bound prompts 09 and 10 inherit for the residual spline.
schema.radiation_controls: rho_G must be bit-exactly zero at every order in exact radiation (C == 0 identically); rho_T is scored against RadiationModel's closed-form primitive, of which review §12.4's 1/x_i - 1/x is the large-x asymptote (and carries the opposite sign in this campaign's convention).

RadiationModel.criterion: rho_T vs the closed form <= 1e-14 relative
